analysis.insight_summary: Several users encounter the 'Download Failed! Invalid name in SD Card.' error when uploading websites to [product_name] modules from a different computer, though it works from their usual PC. The problem recurs for multiple users, suggesting it's common when switching workstations. Since no direct solutions are offered, most users are advised to contact official support. Differences in setup or network configuration might be contributing to the error.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to upload websites to [product_name] hardware from any computer using [product_name] Web Editor without compatibility issues, and want error messages to offer clear, actionable guidance.
